entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker, the first known one, whose spark ignites during the Dragon-killers' War; he shapes Tarkir, is killed and later encased by Sarkhan Vol, and returns in the Omenpath Era.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon and planeswalker who ascends after the Elder Dragon War, fights Ugin, rules Madara, and schemes through the Infinite Consortium and Amonkhet until his defeat in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: The dragon who spawns the first dragons on Dominaria.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Thran who comes to power, reshapes a decaying plane into Phyrexia and wages war on the Thran; he is slain by the combined power of the Legacy.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: A vampire who creates the curse of vampirism on Innistrad with the demon Shilgengar.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker born on Innistrad who helps imprison the Eldrazi and creates Avacyn and the Helvault.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps imprison the Eldrazi, is imprisoned in the Helvault by Sorin, and is later compleated and healed.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A Dominarian artificer born at the start of Argivian Reckoning, who ends the Brothers' War with the Sylex Blast, becomes a planeswalker and wages a crusade against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, born on the last day of the Dominarian year, who is altered by Phyrexian constructs.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: A scholar who discovers Koilos with the brothers and dies when hit by energy beams from the stones.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian demon summoned through the portal at Koilos who fights Urza in the Caves of Koilos.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem built by Urza and Barrin at the Tolarian Academy, who later ascends, creates Memnarch and, on New Phyrexia, unmakes Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A Tolarian Academy founder who helps build Karn and commits suicide by annihilating Tolaria.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A Dominarian mage whose planeswalker spark is triggered by Jodah and who is thrown off the Mana Rig by Ajani.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A near-immortal Dominarian archmage who uses his mirror to trigger Jaya's spark.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: A child who rings the Apocalypse Chime on Ulgrotha and is trapped in a coffin for 220 years.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker angel who unites tribes on Ulgrotha and is killed on Dominaria by an unnamed planeswalker.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels to Tarkir's past, encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon, serves Nicol Bolas, and later wreaks havoc with wild dragons.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A hero born in Benalia who fights Phyrexia and kills Crovax.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: A young Kondo clan member who becomes the Evincar of Rath under Phyrexia.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A Dominarian noble who kills Selenia and Mirri on Rath, becomes a vampire and Evincar of Rath, and is killed by Gerrard.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A spirit bound to Crovax's father's service, killed by Crovax on Rath.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior of the Weatherlight crew killed by Crovax.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker born on Dominaria who ascends, creates the Lich Josu Vess from her brother's corpse, is controlled by Bolas, and later turns on him; she joins the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: A lich created from the corpse of Liliana Vess's brother.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage planeswalker born on Vryn who joins the Gatewatch and, after trying to remake the Multiverse as the Echoverse, dies.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: An aspect of Jace Beleren, a version treated as distinct, who rises above his other aspects to drive the Echoverse plan.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker born on Kaladesh and a founding member of the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and founding Gatewatch member who sacrifices himself for Liliana in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elven planeswalker born on Zendikar who breaks the central hedron, joins the Gatewatch, is compleated and later restored.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker whose spark ignites at thirteen, is killed by Heliod, returns, and carries the Sylex into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch, is compleated, and is later restored.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer planeswalker who takes the Infinite Consortium, serves Nicol Bolas, and brings Sheoldred to Dominaria.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who works for Bolas, finds Jace, becomes his lover, and is compleated.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who seizes power over New Phyrexia and orders the New Phyrexian Invasion until Karn unmakes her.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A Zhalfirin planeswalker who gives up his spark, regains it, and joins the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch and kills Heliod during the invasion.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: An aspect of Trostani who organizes the Ravnican murders and is captured.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who is compleated by Jin-Gitaxias and becomes the first Phyrexian planeswalker.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who compleats Tamiyo.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker who bonds with Realmbreaker and uses its portals to reach Zhalfir.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A Dominarian who ascends and gives her life to close the final rift over Otaria.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The Mirari turned into a being by Karn, who goes mad on Mirrodin and dies trying to take Glissa's spark.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Mirrodin elf who hunts Memnarch and is later compleated by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker desparked by Nahiri, who later regains his spark and begins the Adversary War.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker cursed by the Chain Veil and freed by the Cauldron of Eternity.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon killed by Liliana Vess on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A demon who devours the plane of Duskmourn.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who becomes a planeswalker when Jace's spark flies to her.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: A Strixhaven figure kidnapped by the Dawning Archaic whose death exposes the Theorist to the knowledge of creation.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother, whose healing prowess helps him and Vraska recover.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: The Fomori child locked in the vault of Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: A Kamigawa figure who ends the Madara-Edemi War by slaying Nicol Bolas and others.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A planeswalker from Rabiah who is killed by Urza after Urza joins Phyrexia.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A druid who becomes a planeswalker and sacrifices her spark to heal Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader killed on Capenna when Park Heights is dropped on her.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker compleated by Phyrexia who is killed by Vadrok.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, reunited with her at the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A Theros god who kills Elspeth, is defeated by her, later compleated and killed by Kaya Cassir.

entities.name: Vadrok
entities.description: An Ikoria creature who kills the compleated Lukka and spares Vivien and the refugees.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives on Ravnica, later travels to Ixalan, and is defeated by Jace.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan called to Innistrad by Nahiri, sealed in Innistrad's moon, and later devours the Echoverse.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan destroyed by the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan destroyed by the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Cosmic horrors imprisoned on Zendikar by Sorin, Ugin and Nahiri.

entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: The great dragons of Dominaria born of the Ur-Dragon, whose war is won by Nicol Bolas and others.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: The empire that Yawgmoth wars against and that is destroyed at the Battle of Halcyon.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The inhabitants of Phyrexia who repeatedly invade Dominaria and the Multiverse.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance of planeswalkers sworn to save the planes together.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: An organization led by Nicol Bolas, then Tezzeret, that Jace works for and defects from.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild Vraska takes control of and later compleats.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of Argivian Reckoning, home of Urza, the Brothers' War and two Phyrexian invasions.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city plane governed by guilds under the Guildpact.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Eldrazi are imprisoned and later released.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane of vampires, Avacyn and the Helvault.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane shaped by Ugin where Ugin and Bolas fight.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane Memnarch renames Argentum, later corrupted into New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane that Mirrodin becomes after Phyrexian conquest, led by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The artificial plane Yawgmoth reshapes from a decaying plane.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane with the Immortal Sun and Orazca.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas builds an army of Eternals.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Chandra's home plane.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A plane where the Chain Veil is found.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: A plane ruled by an empire where Bolas becomes god-emperor.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: An artificial plane where Crovax kills Selenia and Mirri.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: The realm where Nicol Bolas kills Ugin and later where Jace becomes custodian.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: A world without suffering created by Jace's aspects.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A frontier plane where the Maag Taranau vault lies.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane devoured by Valgavoth.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods where Elspeth dies and returns.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The void between planes.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: An island on Dominaria obliterated by the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island of the Tolarian Academy, annihilated by Barrin.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: Where Urza fights Gix and the portal to Phyrexia lies.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The Zendikari site whose central hedron Nissa breaks.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The device Urza activates to end the Brothers' War and that is later carried into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A prison created by Sorin that holds Nahiri and is later destroyed.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact on Shandalar that Liliana takes control of.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact Karn turns into Memnarch.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: A phenomenon trapping all planeswalkers in a section of the multiverse.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: An invasion tree used by Wrenn to open portals.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The destruction of Argoth by Urza's Sylex.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: The event that heals Dominaria's fractures and strips planeswalkers of godlike power.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The Ravnican battle ending in Bolas's defeat.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault across the Multiverse ended by Karn unmaking Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The loss of planeswalker sparks after the Sylex Blast in the Blind Eternities.
